canonicalDeployment.note: Canonical 1.0.0-studionet release, deployed on GenLayer Studionet 61999. Complete this record with the deployment transaction hash from the deployer wallet history. The production frontend resolves this address from src/lib/config.ts (env VITE_PACTUM_CONTRACT overrides it).

productionFrontend.hosting: Static single-page build (Vite). Deploy on Vercel with env VITE_PACTUM_CONTRACT set to the canonical address; no database, no backend, reads go straight to the Studionet gateway.
productionFrontend.note: Frontend address selection: VITE_PACTUM_CONTRACT (build env) → src/lib/config.ts PACTUM_CONTRACT fallback. Both must equal canonicalDeployment.address.
